summary: Verified both LessonPlanCreator bug fixes end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_lesson_plan_download.py pass — (a) generate-from-schedule with a Batesville-style 8-row template returns plans[0].sections as a non-empty dict whose keys are the exact template labels (Learner Outcomes / Objectives, Standards, Materials Needed, Anticipatory Set, Modeling, Guided Practice / Monitoring, Independent Practice) and whose values are turtle-focused non-empty strings (no 'Not specified', no print() spam); (b) /download/0 returns a valid 2000+-byte .docx that when opened with python-docx has the second column of ≥5 known-label rows filled in with real content; (c) /download-week for a 3-day schedule returns one .docx with exactly 3 tables plus ≥2 <w:br type=page> page breaks, and every day's sections dict is populated. Frontend: Playwright login → /lesson-plans → confirmed Weekly Schedule card gone (0 'Weekly Schedule' text hits, no lp-generate-schedule / lp-add-schedule-row / lp-schedule-row-* testids), exactly one 'Generate Plan' button (data-testid=generate-plan-btn). Filled Subject=CS, Topic=Turtle Naming, Number of Days=1, selected Turtle Graphics - Chapter 1: First Steps → Lesson 1: Name Your Turtle, clicked Generate. Day 1 card rendered in ~6s with 3 sections whose labels match the uploaded 'Week test' template (Objectives, Anticipatory Set, Closure — NOT the legacy hardcoded set of 8), each with turtle-specific content (e.g. 'Students will be able to create a Turtle Graphics program in Python that assigns a custom name to a turtle and moves it forward by 100 pixels...'). Zero 'Not specified' occurrences. Download .docx button per day is present (data-testid=lp-download-day-0). Week download card correctly absent for 1-day plan and per code (lines 1258-1278) appears only when generatedPlans.length > 1 with populated sections.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 17,279 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Lesson-plan template + generate + download handlers (≈lines 9200-9700, ~500 LOC) are cohesive and should be extracted into /app/backend/routers/lesson_plans.py to slow further monolith growth.

LessonPlanCreator.jsx is 1,451 lines; the day-card rendering IIFE at ~L1329-1438 (sections-dict vs legacy lessonSections branch + inline problem-list nested render) is dense enough to justify extracting a <DayCard /> component with its own tests.

The AI's system prompt tells it to skip labels with no real content, so a docx cell for e.g. 'Standards' can legitimately remain blank when the teacher provides no standards and ai_generate_standards=False. That is correct behaviour but is not obvious from the UI — consider showing an inline hint on the day card (e.g. 'Standards: not generated — enable AI generation or paste your standards to fill this section').
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test template 'TEST_batesville_template' is uploaded and deleted within each pytest module run. Three lesson_plans docs are created by the tests and remain in the DB (they are just Week-of plans in the current teacher's Saved Plans list) — safe to ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression file /app/backend/tests/test_lesson_plan_download.py covers the template-fillable path end-to-end. It builds an in-memory 8-row Batesville-style .docx and asserts (a) sections dict returned by /generate-from-schedule matches template labels + is turtle-grounded, (b) /download/{day_index} returns .docx with filled cells, (c) /download-week returns 3-table combined .docx with page breaks. The download-day test uses ai_generate_standards=True and ai_generate_objectives=True to encourage the AI to fill every label (without these, AI legitimately skips labels with no source data, and the corresponding template cell stays blank — that's expected). Frontend flow: /lesson-plans page. The 'Pull Problems From' section uses shadcn Select (role=combobox), NOT native <select>. Cascade: Unit/Chapter combo populates → Lesson combo appears. Use page.get_by_role('option', name='Turtle Graphics - Chapter 1: First Steps', exact=True).scroll_into_view_if_needed() then .click() (NOT force=True with a hand-picked handle — force-click after scroll can land on a virtualised option). data-testids: generate-plan-btn, lp-download-day-{idx}, lp-download-week-card, lp-download-week-btn. Absent (correctly): lp-generate-schedule, lp-add-schedule-row, lp-schedule-row-*.
rca of the issue: Root cause of both original bugs: (1) 'Not specified' everywhere — the day-card renderer at LessonPlanCreator.jsx L1329-1438 previously walked a hardcoded lessonSections array (keys learnerOutcomes/standards/materials/anticipatorySet/modeling/…), but the new /generate-from-schedule endpoint returns a `sections` dict keyed by the teacher's uploaded template labels (e.g. 'Learner Outcomes / Objectives', 'Anticipatory Set'). Because the two key sets do not intersect, every cell lookup returned undefined and rendered as 'Not specified'. Fix (verified): renderer now uses `day.sections` dict when populated and falls back to legacy `lessonSections` only when sections is empty. (2) Two Generate buttons — the older blue 'Generate Plan' and the emerald Weekly Schedule 'Generate N day(s) of plans' both hit the same endpoint after a previous change, causing confusion. Fix (verified): Weekly Schedule card removed entirely (previously LessonPlanCreator.jsx L933-1041); the surviving blue 'Generate Plan' button now converts the old subject+topic+numberOfDays input into the schedule payload and calls /api/lesson-plans/generate-from-schedule directly (L351-421), so it produces the same structured sections dict + template-fillable docx download as the removed weekly flow did.
